sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Goreu, also called Goreu fab Custennin, is a Welsh hero. He stays a relatively obscure figure. He appears as a hidden child in the tale of Culhwch and Olwen. The giant Ysbaddaden Penkawr, father of Olwen, had eaten his 22 older siblings. King Arthur freed Goreu. He joined the court at Camelot and slew the giant who had harmed his family.

okr.objective: Present Goreu as a hidden child of Culhwch and Olwen who avenged his slain siblings.
